source.provenance: user-supplied Claude Code coordinator + delegated-agent results visible through ChatGPT File Library; not yet hashed/copied into canonical repository by this organ
source.scope_rule: Treat findings as source evidence with explicit model/test scope; do not promote them into target-model runtime credit.

observed_findings.model_scope: Qwen3-0.6B pinned GGUF lane, separate from the trigger2 measured Qwen3.5-0.8B target
observations: holdout lexical overlap with calibration was reported as zero
the injected semantic vector transported mechanistically to the downstream layer
holdout target-code hit remained 0.333 matched versus 0.333 baseline on the 3-way task
a nuisance control produced larger absolute behavioral movement than the semantic condition
observed_findings.bounded_inference: Representation-level transport is not a sufficient training/evaluation objective for behavioral semantic-to-symbol binding.
observed_findings.forbidden_inference: This does not prove the Qwen3.5-0.8B trigger2 target has the same failure mechanism.

observations: prompt-byte and token-tensor hashing mechanisms exist
no single artifact binds both identities together in the tested promotion topology
token-tensor hashing in the inspected path drops dtype and shape
the lineage with broader cross-binding was not the live promotion-gate lineage
observed_findings.bounded_inference: Training/evaluation row provenance should bind prompt bytes and consumed token tensor identity together, including order, dtype and shape, at the lineage that actually makes promotion decisions.

observations: the live CI/runner path used an older unversioned promotion gate while later stricter variants existed but were unreachable
independence in the live path was self-declared by candidate JSON rather than independently measured
control receipt hashes were format-checked rather than recomputed against source bytes
matched-control completeness was not enforced per calibration family
wrong-layer/lesion/rescue evidence was absent from the live decision path
observed_findings.bounded_inference: A green candidate-owned validator cannot authenticate trigger2 training success. Independent recomputation and the exact live retained gate path are mandatory.

training_design_return.keep_current_primary_objective: episode-local semantic-class -> realized codebook mapping -> exact output atom
new_hard_requirements: Every evaluation family reports behavior and internal transport separately; internal transport never substitutes for behavioral binding accuracy.
Matched nuisance/sham/off-target controls are evaluated per family and must not systematically outperform the intended binding intervention.
Exact prompt-byte hash and consumed token-tensor hash are cross-bound in one trial identity; token tensor identity includes dtype and shape.
The promotion validator independently recomputes class-symbol independence, realized S3 mapping, target derivation, receipt/source hashes and matched-control completeness.
The exact gate called by the live training/evaluation path is version-bound; unreachable stricter validator files receive zero promotion credit.
Post-training causal evidence requires lesion/shuffle/rescue of the learned binding path while semantic readability is preserved.

adversarial_training_and_eval_pairs_adde.construction: Keep a semantically decodable case and successfully transported internal semantic direction, but randomly permute the episode-local codebook after semantic extraction.
adversarial_training_and_eval_pairs_adde.expected: The model must still derive the output from the current realized codebook. A hidden-state coordinate matching the semantic class but an incorrect output atom is FAIL.
adversarial_training_and_eval_pairs_adde.purpose: Prevents proxy-objective success from being counted as binding success.

adversarial_training_and_eval_pairs_adde.construction: Include a matched nuisance intervention/control that preserves the episode mapping but perturbs an unrelated direction with matched magnitude.
adversarial_training_and_eval_pairs_adde.expected: The nuisance arm must not exceed the intended binding arm on the preregistered behavioral metric beyond the declared tolerance.
adversarial_training_and_eval_pairs_adde.purpose: Detects non-specific steering and control failure.

adversarial_training_and_eval_pairs_adde.construction: Use token tensors with identical flattened token values but different declared shape/dtype in a synthetic validator fixture.
adversarial_training_and_eval_pairs_adde.expected: Trial identity must differ or the malformed/mismatched tensor must be rejected; hash equality from flattened values alone is insufficient.
adversarial_training_and_eval_pairs_adde.purpose: Hardens consumed-input provenance before any training/evaluation credit.

adversarial_training_and_eval_pairs_adde.construction: Candidate metadata claims class-symbol independence=true while the realized row distribution is intentionally imbalanced.
adversarial_training_and_eval_pairs_adde.expected: Independent validator rejects the family after recomputing counts and mutual information.
adversarial_training_and_eval_pairs_adde.purpose: Prevents candidate-owned booleans from minting scientific credit.

adversarial_training_and_eval_pairs_adde.construction: Supply syntactically valid hex64 receipt digests that do not match the referenced prompt/codebook/source bytes.
adversarial_training_and_eval_pairs_adde.expected: Validator recomputes the hashes and rejects the trial.
adversarial_training_and_eval_pairs_adde.purpose: Prevents provenance from becoming a cosmetic schema field.

adversarial_training_and_eval_pairs_adde.construction: A candidate contains one complete calibration family and one incomplete family missing a required control.
adversarial_training_and_eval_pairs_adde.expected: Promotion fails for the candidate; completeness is checked per family, not once globally.

swarm_review.EVIDENCE_EXTRACTOR: accepted T01/T05/T06 findings only at their explicit scopes
swarm_review.ADVERSARIAL_SHORTCUT_HUNTER: flagged hidden-state transport as a dangerous proxy objective and self-declared independence as a shortcut
swarm_review.STATISTICAL_REVIEWER: requires family-level matched controls and recomputed class-symbol independence
swarm_review.ABI_PROVENANCE_REVIEWER: requires prompt+tensor cross-binding including dtype/shape and byte-level receipt recomputation
swarm_review.RETENTION_REVIEWER: no change to the narrow binding-only training objective; existing semantic/write abilities remain protected
swarm_review.HARNESS_COMPATIBILITY_REVIEWER: requires the same exact live gate path plus lesion/shuffle/rescue instrumentation in future go harness work

next_exact_action: Fuse these negative-control requirements into the permutation-causal renderer/validator that materializes the canonical 72-row trigger2 seed; do not scale lexical volume until row-level provenance, controls and independent validation pass.
